Interesting! After SPACE, two new W (white) nodes with 3 pixels each appeared (nodes 1 and 7), and the B frame nodes changed from 64 to 61 pixels each. In other words, SPACE created small white marks — probably on the top and bottom frame borders. Let's find their positions.
